reviews.x: My 3 year old is autistic my children are mexican& black so have thick/course/curly hair which grows quick! He can't stand to have his hair cut and while my others have long curly hair Noah cannot because he cant stand the maintenance. I've gone through so many clippers..its TORTURE!! He screams cries as though he's in severe pain having a traumatic experience. We never get an even cut because I (we) can only deal with the situation for a short time. I used these clippers on him and while there

Used this cordless trimmer for the first time on my 1-Year old and it was absolutely GREAT! The trimmer is quiet, light weight and super easy to use. The trimmer comes with multiple guards to give you the perfect length for whatever style of haircut you want. I would recommend when first starting out, to use the largest guard which I did. I was surprised how short that guard left his hair, so I am  thankful to have not started with a smaller guard. Overall, I would highly recommend this trimmer,

This was for my baby's first haircut, we were not sure how it would go. It went really well! This clipper is easy to use, and it cleans well. Waterproof as well. Lightweight so you won't feel the burden of holding it for a while, I also likes the cute shape. And the most important thing is that this clipper makes almost NO noise while being used! It has totally exceeded my expectation, and I've already recommended it to my friends.  Confortble and easy to use in our newborn baby. Easy to clean.

I bought these for a while and have not started to use it till pandemic starts. This is definitely a must have if you plan to do your child’s haircut at home. It’s so easy to use. I’ve never do my son’s hair cut before but it turns out to be pretty nice. The noice level is not too loud and My little one was ok with it. I charge it once then used it for at least four times so I would say the battery life is good. Now we don’t need to take my little one out for haircut and saved money.

We bought this for our son who has sensory sensitivities and can’t handle a normal hair trimmer. This trimmer is quiet but still does a great job! We used this last week and he did great for the most part. We did have one issue with one of the heads not staying on while we were cutting his hair, I contacted the company and they sent a brand new one free of charge. I would definitely recommend this for any parent who has a child with SPD!

reviews.t: Great Product.  Not as scary on my kid as a grown-up pair of clippers.
reviews.x: My 2 year old is terrified of the barber's clippers, so we bought this one to do at home, and it's worked out great.  We just plunk him in front of an ipad to distract him, and the clippers are gentle and quiet enough that he doesn't notice them that much.  Part of the teeth are plastic which worried me at first, but if you oil the blade (small amt included), it should work smoothly, and we havnt had any hair snags so far.

I used this baby clippers to cut my baby's hair for the very first time. It is light, handheld with battery. Super easy to use. The guide comb is very easy to install, and safe to use. Surprisingly my baby was very peaceful throughout the whole process. I recommend this product to others who would like to find an affordable and easy to use clipper for their babies.

Best best best for Babies . Specially For the ones who are super active . I have a very active baby and this was a life saver . Hi have cut hair for the first time ever and it was a cake walk for me . 0 scratches , very less noise . Super safe and clean and effective . Very impressive. Strongly recommend!

Edit: Customer service for this company is five stars! They will contact you and try to fix your problem! Unfortunately Amazon didn't let me return the item (since the refund was issued instead of a replacement). Unfortunately I would have to keep the defective clipper because of COVID and not buy another one ( saving money :/). But I think I can make it work. I was thinking instead of grabbing the clipper from the handle, I would grab it from where it locks. Or maybe taping it. I think I would

These clippers do the job! They’re a little hard to get used to at first if you’ve never trimmed hair before, but my kiddo ended up with a mowhalk as planned and we love it! Plus we have a wiggly toddler and he wasn’t afraid of it so that was HUGE! So we’re happy!  The one real downfall I had was the fact that hair gets into some of the shaving heads and I couldn’t get it out with the brush tool; not sure if the parts are able to be disassembled to be cleaned. Not a deal breaker but inconvenient

Compared to the Philips clipper, this one has more combs and mesh cover, which makes it more versatile. That helps a lot when it comes to finer trimming my baby's hair. Additionally, the spec says it's noise level is even slightly lower than the Philips one, which is huge consideration for baby's hair clipper. Loud noise can scare baby away from getting close to the clipper. Plus, the quality is decent, it does not looks made from cheap material. Overall, FIVE STAR!

At first my 3 year old wouldn’t let me near him with these even though they are so quiet. Then we had to give woody and haircut, and then buzz. The bed hold them against his foot, and his arm to see they were gentle. Then he took it to his own hair and I had to take them from him. :) and now I’m working on my hair cutting skills to save money and keep him from being traumatized at the barber shop. I definitely recommend these

This is a really easy use for child haircut. My son, 3 year olds, always dislikes to go barber shop and cut his hair. This makes us cut his hair in my home and he feels relax before his toys because this is quiet and we can cut his hair easily letting him play the toys or watching his favorite movies. There are many sizes of attachment and larger size is very useful for first cutting until getting use of this clipper.

LOVED these clippers. They were great. Made cutting hair a breeze. They worked for about 6 months (aka approx 4-5 haircuts) Now they no longer hold a charge/turn on. Thankfully, they were pretty reasonably priced, but now having to replace them so soon after purchasing, I wish I had just bought the more expensive ones from the beginning. Overall, I do recommend, but just be aware that these may not last even a year ☹

reviews.t: Great hair trimmer for the baby
reviews.x: Bought this to give my little one her first haircut during the pandemic. Without worrying about accidentally cutting my baby using the scissors, this  hair trimmer makes life a lot easier. I trimmed my baby’s hair when she’s asleep. The noise of the trimmer is really low. My baby didn’t even realize I cut for her. Only took me 10min and it’s done! Easy! Quick! Hassle free!

We received it today and we are so happy! It is very easy to use. I wouldn’t say is a quiet machine, it does have a sound but not loud at all. Cut my toddler’s hair today. It was fast and easy. Perfect size. I was able to fix the borders with the special little blade. Easy to clean with the little brush. I am just thinking that this is a must if you have a baby boy.

reviews.t: Main blade won’t lock into place but got it replaced.
reviews.x: Unfortunately main blade doesn’t lock into place. The other two did but didn’t really need those.  Update. The company reached out about the issue and offered the refund or to replace. I took the replacement and it works as expected. Didn’t update to all five stars since I had to take extra time to get it sorted out but am thankful I got one that locks in place now.

The attachments don't lock properly with the body of the trimmer and as a result they move and fall once the trimmer is turned on, creating a hazard for the baby. This should not happen at this price point, but I guess quality control is not properly done! I have read a few reviews saying the same.. so obviously the brand has not fixed this issue. Will be returning

reviews.t: perfect trimmer what i really looking for
reviews.x: This seems to be the most efficient trimmer I've been looking for. The sound is not too loud and most of all it is very convenient because it is rechargeable. There are various parts, so you can use it conveniently when you want. The best part is that there is no fear of injury and the cleaning is simple. You must buy this and try it out.

Cutting my 3 1/2 year olds hair is a dreaded task I try to avoid for as long as possible. He hates the noise and vibration of clippers. My only issue with these clippers is I wish I ordered them sooner! What a pleasant and hassle free experience we had. Amazing product for all kids, especially sensitive toddlers! Highly recommend!

reviews.t: Great hair trimmer, quiet and simple to use
reviews.x: I really like this simple baby hair clipper/buzzer package. It is easy to use and simple to understand, I have tried it on my toddler boy, noise is very minimal, and cut/trim well. It is also waterproof so that is definitely a great plus for easy cleaning. I like the bright colors, overall I am very satisfied with this product.

reviews.t: Razor head falls off too easily but all in all not bad
reviews.x: This had such a great review I purchased it without second thought and the first few times I used it I assumed it must be human error that the razor head kept falling off. But now I realize it's just so loose and actually doesn't lock on so mid-trim it will start to turn and wiggle.  This happens with both default razor heads.

reviews.t: Perfect trimmer for myself and my toddler
reviews.x: Bought this trimmer after seeing the reviews and I'm impressed. I am satisfied with the product so far in that it does what it's supposed to do and love the fact that it's wireless. Was able to cut my boy's hair without giving me any problems. Would be glad to recommend this to others who wish to cut their own hair at home.

These baby clippers worked awesome for my 6 month old. This was for his first cut and wanted something that would have reduced noise to avoid traumatizing him with the regular buzzer sound.He has baby hair so we didn’t need anything to extreme to cut off the hair. These did the trick,It’s a bonus that they’re water proof!

Used it for my five year old to replace a Phillips kids clipper. Fished the haircut without any issue. Nice options to chose from different length of guide combs. For cleaning, there seems to be a layer of lubricant oil inside the slot, leaving the hair sticking inside. Will need to try wash with water next time.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how quiet the trimmer is, which helps keep babies and children calm during haircuts.
Many parents find it easy to use, lightweight, and safe for at-home baby and toddler haircuts, including first haircuts.
It is especially valued by parents of children with sensory sensitivities or autism who can't tolerate regular clippers.
A few reviewers report durability problems, with the clipper failing to hold a charge or turn on after several months.
Some users mention minor issues like a head not staying attached or a learning curve for first-time trimmers.
